question: Where can I get the boundaries (geometry) of protected natural areas in Spain, at every designation level (international, national and regional), with category and designation date?

answer.summary: The IEPNB/MITECO GeoServer WFS (iepnb.gob.es/geoserver) serves geometry for all Spanish protected areas: ENP (1785, includes regional figures), Red Natura 2000 (1865) and international sites (178), each with figure, IUCN category and designation YEAR (anio_alta). Full dates: MITECO MAB files, EEA Natura 2000 tables, Ramsar RSIS and 9 of 17 regional layers; other regions give a norm or only the year.
main_caveats: anio_alta and EEA legalFoundationDate are a YEAR. For Donana RN2000 the WFS says 1997 but the EEA Natura table has DATE_SPA 1987-09-01 and DATE_SAC 2012-09: they are not the same event.
WFS list_normas comes out as 'Java String[]@hash' (unreadable); norms must be read elsewhere (Natura SPA/SAC_LEGAL_REFERENCE, Ramsar RAM_BOE, Andalucia NOR_DECLA).
ENP layer mixes figures that overlap (Natura 2000 entries, Zonas Humedas, Cuevas, Arbol Singular...). Do not add areas by feature; 1785 is the official count.

Catalonia ENPE mirror (gissrv.diba.cat) returns empty rings and ANY_APROV in only 4 of 389 rows; the IDEC OGC API has the Generalitat data. MITECO Ramsar GeoJSON zip is empty (22 bytes); use the shp zip.
EEA CDDA service is v21 (data to March 2023, 1852 ES sites); MITECO/IEPNB are Dec 2025. Counts differ between sources (ENP 1785 vs 1852).
answer.confidence_reason: Services and files queried and counted at all levels, including all 17 communities; open_questions remain on what anio_alta records and on the two cities' own data.

how_to_use.example_request: https://iepnb.gob.es/geoserver/ows?service=WFS&version=2.0.0&request=GetFeature&typeNames=ENP:enp&count=1&outputFormat=application/json&srsName=EPSG:4326&cql_filter=nombre='Doñana'  (counts: add resultType=hits; layers RN2000:rn2000 and convenio_internacional:conv_internacional; international only: curl -G ... --data-urlencode outputFormat=application/json, 178 features, 23 MB)
how_to_use.example_result: ENP Doñana: MultiPolygon, designacion Parque Natural, cod_desig ES10, anio_alta 1989, nombre_categoria_iucn 'Paisaje terrestre y marino protegido', nombre_organismo 'Junta de Andalucía'. RN2000 Doñana: id_ref ES0000024, desc_figura 'LIC/ZEC + ZEPA', anio_alta 1997, superficie_oficial 128267.84. conv_internacional Ramsar 'Colas del embalse de Ullibarri-Gamboa': anio_alta 2002.
steps: Use curl -G with --data-urlencode for cql_filter values (accents, quotes).
Choose typeNames: ENP:enp, RN2000:rn2000 or convenio_internacional:conv_internacional; add srsName=EPSG:4326 (native epsg_origen differs: 25830, 32628).
Without count the server returns all features: ENP 1785, RN2000 1865, conv_internacional 178 (23 MB GeoJSON).
Filter conv_internacional by nombre_figura_proteccion_pda to split Ramsar, MAB, Geoparks, OSPAR, ZEPIM, World Heritage.
Use propertyName=... (without geom) for light attribute tables; resultType=hits for counts.
Join RN2000 id_ref to the EEA Natura 2000 table (SITECODE) for exact SPA/SAC dates.
reading_traps: anio_alta is a year only and is not the SPA/SAC date (Doñana RN2000: 1997 here vs DATE_SPA 1987-09-01 in EEA table).
list_normas returns 'Ljava.lang.String;@hash' in GeoJSON and cannot be read.
anio_alta null in 1 of 1785 ENP rows; dado_de_baja=1 in none.
ENP figures overlap (e.g. 'Espacio Protegido Red Natura 2000' 79, 'Zonas Húmedas' 55, 'Cuevas' 134, 'Árbol Singular' 47 in the MITECO file) so sums of areas double count.
conv_internacional has 55 MAB rows vs 59 features in MITECO MAB file; ZEPIM 10 vs 19; counts differ by how parts are split.
Layer abstract is empty and GetCapabilities gives no dates; no WMS/WFS licence beyond the site aviso legal.

steps: Query layer 4 (large scale) or 3 with where=cddaCountryCode='ES'; maxRecordCount 2000 (1852 fits).
Layer 0 (points) has 0 ES records.
Request outSR=4326 with f=geojson for WGS84 geometry (service native is Web Mercator).

Newest public data (v23, Aug 2025): GPKG files in the EEA datashare folder, reachable with WebDAV user 'sptXqwkQr5g7Bp5' (empty password): NatDA_2025_v01_public_WorldEPSG4326.gpkg 1,590,833,152 bytes and ..._EuropeEPSG3035.gpkg 1,584,050,176 bytes; Range requests work (206); not downloaded (over 100 MB).
reading_traps: Service name says v21 but layer copyright text says 'Original CDDA v19'; data to March 2023.
legalFoundationDate is a year; min 1918, max 2022, filled in all 1852.
1852 ES records vs 1785 in MITECO ENP: different scope (CDDA includes Natura-type designations and boundaries).
Boundaries are generalised by scale layer; not tested for precision.
Geometry request for the whole country is large; page by resultOffset.
v23 GPKG files are 1.5-1.6 GB each; the share root is the whole EEA datastore (1.58 TB), so a plain /download of the share is not usable.

problems: Public share link streams a zip of the whole datastore; use WebDAV paths. GPKG v23 only checked by headers and a Range read (SQLite header).

steps: Use the member's data_url; each community has its own protocol (WFS 1.1/2.0, ArcGIS REST, OGC API Features, zip).

Read dates from the fields in key_fields; they are not harmonised (note Aragón dates are UTC midnight of the previous day: 1982-07-12T22:00Z is 13 July in Spain).
Pattern for another service: look for 'IDE' + community, then a GetCapabilities or REST directory and search layer names for 'ENP', 'espacios', 'protegidos'.

recipe: Take the area's name and code from the IEPNB WFS (ENP, RN2000 or conv_internacional).

Get the legal act: Natura sites from SPA_LEGAL_REFERENCE / SAC_LEGAL_REFERENCE in the EEA table; Ramsar from RAM_BOE in the MITECO shp (number and date of the BOE notice); Andalucía from NOR_DECLA in the REDIAM WFS; other ENP from the region's bulletin.
Open the act in BOE (tested: BOE-A-1969-1252 gives disposition date 16/10/1969) and read the date of disposition and publication.
Store the year from anio_alta as a fallback when no act is found.
